hypotheses.market_question: Does the canonical 250-pip Large Quarter Point grid contain unique short-horizon continuation information on GBPUSD?
hypotheses.null: Canonical Large Quarter Points do not outperform matched nearby 50-pip round-level controls on the frozen 60-minute continuation endpoint.
hypotheses.alternative: Canonical Large Quarter Points show a positive and stable continuation effect relative to matched controls.
hypotheses.mechanism: If Quarters Theory describes a privileged price grid, crossings of canonical Large Quarter Points should alter continuation probability/return beyond generic round-number geometry.

method.primary_endpoint: Direction-aligned midpoint return 60 minutes after an eligible crossing.
method.event_definition: Candidate levels every 50 pips; canonical phase 0 modulo 250; midpoint crossing; 25-pip directional rearm.
controls: 50-pip round levels at phases 50, 100, 150 and 200, matched by year, direction, roundness and four-hour UTC session.
variants: Frozen Stage-1 endpoint and reset sensitivity reported in source artifacts.

holdout.prior_exposure: none for this Quarters programme at Stage-1
